title: Angleton as OSS man in Italy
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Angleton as OSS man in Italy, about 1940s at Italy, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: made it clear to me that um James Jesus Angleton was the US like OSS person involved in Italy at the time.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says a guest named Pippa Malmgren made it clear to him that an American intelligence man, James Jesus Angleton, was the key person in Italy in the 1940s for the OSS, the United States' wartime spy service. Michels tells it because it would put Angleton at the centre of whatever was going on in Italy at that time.
